suspicion: CSA-D-05: a raw-39 school-immunity holder taking covered caster-delivered (self) raw-165 damage diverges from Trinity, which would zero it.
why_rejected: Trinity applies school immunity only to negative effects: Unit::IsImmunedToSpell skips an immunity entry unless NegativeEffects & effectMask or the immunity aura has SPELL_ATTR1_IMMUNITY_TO_HOSTILE_AND_FRIENDLY_EFFECTS (Unit.cpp:7797-7800), and Unit::IsImmunedToDamage(caster, spellInfo) skips it for spellInfo->IsPositive() under the same attribute test (Unit.cpp:7890-7891); Spell.cpp:2912 (damage-time check) and Object.cpp:1957 (SpellHitResult) both route through these. A raw-165 DAMAGE_FROM_MAX_HEALTH_PCT effect is not in the negative-effect switch of _isPositiveEffectImpl (SpellInfo.cpp:4747-4767), targets TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (positive target) and therefore returns positive (SpellInfo.cpp:5062); no TDB/SpellMgr override exists for 1257873. The only admitted provider 161901 has no attributes. So Trinity also lands the damage: Core matches the consumer. Every raw-165 (1,0) row that passes Core owner-attribute gates lacks ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF (raw 26, uncataloged) and IsHarmful effect attributes (census, scratch/R1). Core's own catalog row names the slice "admitted positive neutral self-targeted". Residual: only the catalog wording "assumes absent immunity" (spell_effect.rs:262) is stale, info.

suspicion: CSA-C-01 scope: every beneficial / buff / resource impact is critical-eligible (evidence "every beneficial impact regardless of has_damage").
why_rejected: In prepare_impact_quotes "beneficial" means has_healing (planning.rs:808); a critical is prepared only for periodic-health, healing, Target-recipient, or damage impacts (planning.rs:850-935). A Caster-recipient aura-only self buff never resolves Critical: probe r1_real_rows.rs::holds_real_player_self_buff_impact_never_resolves_critical (real 156021 under Player crit 1.0 -> Hit). The finding survives only for Target-recipient impacts without amounts (defect_exact_stun_crits_from_enemy_weapon_channel_with_zero_spell_chance).

suspicion: CSA-J-05 two-source witness: 60 s with +50/+60 gives Core 24999 where Trinity gives 25000.
why_rejected: Trinity forms the recovery-rate product first and multiplies once: recoveryRate *= 100/(amount+100) per aura, then int64(cooldown * recoveryRate) (SpellHistory.cpp:432-455). 60000 * (100/150 * 100/160) = 24999.999999999996 -> 24999, equal to Core. Only the single-source 16.5 s / +10 witness diverges (Core 14999, Trinity 15000), and R3 found no real raw-286/raw-148 amount x SpellCooldowns value that diverges. Supports R3 (REJ-R3-002): LATENT, info.

suspicion: CSA-K-01 Set-mode clause: a real raw-289 Set-mode row executes with a wrong stack count because Core can only Add/Remove.
why_rejected: Of 21 base-difficulty raw-289 Set-mode rows, one passes the owner-attribute audit: Golden Hubris 1213197 (Set 7 on 1213195, (1,0)). Its target aura 1213195 has CumulativeAura 7, so the best host declaration AddAuraStacks{count: 7} yields min(current+7, 7) = 7 from any state, identical to Trinity SetStackAmount(7) (SpellEffects.cpp:6126-6146). No real Set-mode row is observably wrong for a faithful host; the identity/direction clauses need a host declaration that contradicts its own source row (validation fail-open).
